I think Joe Jonas is listed as one of the writers, but there might be others. Maybe other members of DNCE? The band includes Jack Lawless, Cole Whittle, and JinJoo Lee, but I don't know if they all contributed to writing.

Also, sometimes professional songwriters co-write with artists. I recall that the song was written by Joe Jonas, Justin Tranter, and Mattman & Robin. Wait, Mattman & Robin are a songwriting/production duo, right? Their real names are Mattias Larsson and Robin Fredriksson. And Justin Tranter is a well-known songwriter who's worked with many pop artists.

Let me check if that's accurate. I think I read somewhere that there was a funny story behind the title. They originally meant to write "sex on the beach," which is a cocktail name, but the producers kept saying "cake by the ocean" by mistake, and they decided to go with it. So the title is a malapropism. That makes sense because the song's lyrics are kind of playful and nonsensical in a fun way.

So putting it all together: the songwriters are Joe Jonas, Justin Tranter, and Mattman & Robin (Mattias Larsson and Robin Fredriksson). I should confirm if Mattman & Robin are credited as two separate people or as a duo. Usually, they are listed together as a production team. So the official credits would list Joe Jonas, Justin Tranter, Mattias Larsson, and Robin Fredriksson.

Let me think if there's any other contributor. Sometimes there are more people involved, but I think those are the main ones. I need to be careful not to confuse band members with songwriters. Even if other DNCE members are in the band, they might not have contributed to the writing. Another check: looking up past knowledge, "Cake by the Ocean" was written by Joe Jonas, Justin Tranter, and Mattman & Robin. Yes, that seems right. So the answer is those four people, but Mattman & Robin are two individuals. So total four writers: Joe Jonas, Justin Tranter, Mattias Larsson, and Robin Fredriksson.

Wait, but sometimes Mattman & Robin are credited as a duo, so maybe it's listed as three credits: Joe Jonas, Justin Tranter, and Mattman & Robin. But technically, Mattman & Robin are two people, so the full list would include all four names.

I think the official credits do list all four names. For example, on ASCAP or BMI databases, they would have the individual writers. Let me confirm with an example. If I recall correctly, on the album credits for DNCE's self-titled EP, the song is credited to Jonas, Tranter, Larsson, and Fredriksson.

Yes, so the correct answer is that the song was written by Joe Jonas, Justin Tranter, Mattias Larsson, and Robin Fredriksson.
[/Thinking]

Sangen "Cake by the Ocean" ble skrevet av **Joe Jonas**, **Justin Tranter**, **Mattias Larsson** og **Robin Fredriksson**. Larsson og Fredriksson er kjent som produsentduoen **Mattman & Robin**. 

Sangen ble utgitt i 2015 som debutlåt fra bandet **DNCE**, der Joe Jonas er frontfigur. Interessant nok oppstod tittelen av en misforståelse under skriveprosessen: Produsentene mente opprinnelig å referere til cocktailen "Sex on the Beach", men sa ved en feil "Cake by the Ocean", noe som ble beholdt som tittel. 

Krediteringene reflekterer altså samarbeidet mellom Jonas, den erfarne låtskriveren Tranter og produsentparet Mattman & Robin. 🎵
